erdCloud.instructions: 이 파일은 자체 스키마 교환 형식입니다. ERD Cloud Upload Snapshot에는 lms.erdcloud.json을 사용하세요.

checks.name: ck_attendance_time
checks.expression: check_out IS NULL OR check_in IS NULL OR check_out >= check_in

checks.name: ck_correction_original_status
checks.expression: original_status IS NULL OR original_status IN ('PRESENT','LATE','EARLY','ABSENT','EXCUSED','LEAVE')

checks.name: ck_attempt_score
checks.expression: score IS NULL OR score BETWEEN 0 AND 100

checks.name: ck_file_parent
checks.expression: (CASE WHEN post_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN assignment_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN submission_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1

checks.name: ck_review_quiz_selected_choice
checks.expression: selected_choice IS NULL OR selected_choice BETWEEN 1 AND 4
